violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: CLASSIC CHICKEN BREAST AT 73F FOR 2 HOURS ON RACK ON COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE CONSIDER USE REFRIGERATOR TO COOL FOODS FROM 135F TO 70F WITHIN 2 HOURS AND TO A FURTHER 41F WITHIN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE EXITED THROUGH KITCHEN BACK DOOR AND ATTEMPTED TO APPLY CLEAN GLOVES WITHOUT WASHING HANDS ON RETURN TO KITCHEN WORK AREA.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS ON RETURN TO KITCHEN BEFORE DONNING GLOVES. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES CONTINUED TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. OBSERVED MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 159F REGISTERED ON DISH TEMP AFTER 4 RUNS OF THE HIGH TEMPERATURE DISHWASHING MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. EDUCATION PROVIDED. MANAGEMENT PLACED SERVICE ORDER FOR REPAIR OF DISHWASHING MACHINE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE USE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK FOR WASH/RINSE/SANITIZING OF ALL KITCHENWARE AND UTENSILS UNTIL UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN PROVIDE MINIMUM HEAT SANITIZING TEMPERATURE OF 160F. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.
